Name: Female Farmer Overhaul Continued 1.6 (CP)
Author: JennericUsername
Description:
[b]This mod has been updated to work with game version 1.6. [/b]I am not the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/112490403?tab=user+files]mod author[/url], but I am continuing the work to improve the mod's functions and appearance while maintaining the code[size=4].
[font=Arial]
[/font][/size][font=Arial][size=5][b]Contents[/b][/size][/font]
 - 112 new and edited shirts
 - 5 edited pants
 - Female body redone with an option of long sleeves and short sleeves
 - 54 new hairstyles of various lengths 
 - Three config options for brighter hairstyles
 - Completely redone accessories including nose blush, freckles, headbands, and a choker.
 - [s]Dynamic Sleeves based on weather[/s]  (broken)
   [i]// Sleeves are configurable to be either short or long.[/i]
 - New shoe colors
 - New skin colors

PLEASE NOTE: This mod does not add items, but instead replaces some of the current options.
[font=Arial][size=5]
[b]Config Options[/b][/size][/font][b] [u]
[/u][/b][b]If you use the “Mod Generic Config Menu,” [u]changes will not properly occur until you restart your game[/u].[/b][b]
[/b]
Within the config file, you will see the following:
 
  "Accessories": "true",
  "Hats": "true",
  "Hairstyles": "true",
  "HairHue": "2",
  "Shirts": "true",
  "Sleeves": "short",
  "FarmerBaseChanges": "true",
  "ExternalFarmerBaseChanges": "false",
  "ShoeColors": "true",
  "SkinColors": "true"

See the README text doc inside the mod's folder for further explanation.
[size=5]
[/size][b][size=5]In Progress[/size][/b]
- Edits for vanilla sprite lovers to improve how some shirts fit.
- Edits to improve the long sleeve function.
- Clothing assets for Fashion Sense framework.
- Finding a fix for dynamic sleeves.
[i] // Sleeves that change with the weather and season require that the farmer_girl_base sprite reloads each time a condition changes. The game will not do this and will only load one of the base sprites each time the game starts. I’ve spent a lot of time trying to find a solution within the bounds of Content Patcher. Let me know if you have a fix.
[/i][size=5][b]
